channel.title: TDS Journal (English)
channel.description: Hands-on articles on digitalization for businesses, web development and automation — the journal of Tracht Digital Solutions, Schwarzenbek near Hamburg.

item.title: Why product upkeep doesn't have to be tied to a desk
item.description: People taking in stock are rarely at a computer. What changes when items and stock can be maintained from a phone.

item.title: Why a concept is cheaper than a second attempt
item.description: Planning feels like spending before anything happens. In fact it is the stage where changes cost almost nothing.

item.title: Spreadsheet or a tool of your own? An honest way to decide
item.description: A spreadsheet carries you surprisingly far. There are three points, though, where it reliably tips over.

item.title: Is an online shop worth it for my local business?
item.description: Not for every range of products. Four questions that usually answer it for you.

item.title: Five things missing from your website — and costing you enquiries
item.description: Most websites don't fail on design. They fail because one simple question goes unanswered.

item.title: Digitalization doesn't start with a big project
item.description: It starts with the one routine that costs hours every week — the one nobody but you can see.
